backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with authorization mixin and extensive type definitions for props, picks, settlement, diagnostics, and edge calculations.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains summaries of various frontend files including routing, components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS file defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying base styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app and favicon metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring QueryClient, theming, parlay context, and router.
frontend/src/components/account/Principa: Card component displaying the user's principal ID with copy-to-clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/alerts/MarketAle: Panel component that fetches and displays significant recent market line movements.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminOnly.t: Wrapper that renders children only for authenticated admin users and shows an alert otherwise.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with automatic cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginRequir: UI card prompting the user to log in when accessing protected content.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication gate that initializes identity, auto-registers users, and shows loading or login states.
frontend/src/components/error/ErrorState: Error display component showing generic or authorization-specific error messages.
frontend/src/components/landing/DailyTop: Displays a list of top daily edges as cards with stats, confidence, and an option to add each item to a parlay. Shows an alert when no edges are available.
frontend/src/components/landing/Settleme: Fetches and displays settlement performance metrics including win rate and ROI with loading, error, and empty states. Renders a metrics dashboard when data is available.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header navigation, branding, and dynamic parlay leg count. Wraps children in a full‑screen layout.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePickCar: Renders a card for a live pick with game status, player info, odds, and higher/lower selection controls. Highlights live games and supports user selection.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksGr: Displays a responsive grid of LivePickCard components, wiring selection state and handlers. Shows an empty message when no picks match.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksRo: Empty placeholder file for row actions in the live picks UI.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksSt: Provides buttons to filter live picks by game status such as all, live, final, or upcoming. Highlights the selected filter.
frontend/src/components/live/LivePicksTa: Empty placeholder file for a table view of live picks.
frontend/src/components/loading/LoadingS: Shows a centered loading spinner with an optional message.
frontend/src/components/parlay/AddToParl: Toggles adding or removing an edge from the parlay, showing different states and respecting max leg limits with a tooltip.
frontend/src/components/parlay/CopySumma: Copies a formatted parlay summary to the clipboard and shows success or error feedback.
frontend/src/components/props/Confidence: Displays a badge indicating high confidence with size‑adjustable styling.
frontend/src/components/props/PropBoardR: Provides row‑level actions on the prop board, including adding to a parlay and navigating to the prop details page.
Expandable UI component showing edge details, lines, confidence, and verification summary for a prop.
frontend/src/components/props/ValueBar.t: Displays a confidence percentage bar with color based on edge direction or shows unavailable state.
frontend/src/components/settings/Sensiti: Settings card allowing users to configure edge thresholds, rolling windows, and alerts with backend persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useGrantAdm: Mutation hook to grant a principal admin role and refresh admin queries with toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useManualRe: Triggers backend data import and invalidates key queries to refresh edges and props.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useRefreshL: Runs backend live picks refresh and invalidates related queries with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useRunSettl: Executes settlement if supported by backend and refreshes diagnostics, handling missing implementation gracefully.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useSaveCall: Saves the current user's profile and invalidates the user profile query.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useSaveProv: Saves ingestion provider configuration and refreshes related queries with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useTestOpti: Tests the Optic Odds API connection through the backend and reports failures via toast.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useUpdateSe: Validates and saves sensitivity settings, then invalidates dependent queries with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useCallerUser: Fetches the caller's user profile when identity and actor are ready, exposing loading state correctly.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useEdges.ts: Retrieves all edges and enriches each with prop, projection, and verification details.
Fetches live picks with polling enabled when actor and identity are available.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useLivePicksD: Loads diagnostic information for live picks once actor and identity are initialized.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useLivePicksL: Fetches the last-updated timestamp for live picks with periodic polling.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useMarketAler: Polls for market alerts when enabled in settings, currently returning an empty placeholder array.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/usePropDetail: Fetches detailed prop information including edges for a specific prop ID.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useProviderCo: Retrieves the current ingestion provider configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useRefreshSta: Determines the most recent update timestamp from NBA props to report refresh status.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useSensitivit: Fetches a user's sensitivity settings via react-query, enabled when actor and identity are available.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useSettlement: Loads settlement diagnostics from the actor or returns placeholder values if unsupported.
Retrieves settlement metrics from the actor or provides fallback defaults if not implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, including login, logout, identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsAdmin.ts: Checks whether the current caller is an admin using an actor query tied to the user's identity.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables plus background textures for the app.
frontend/src/lib/edges/applyEdgeThreshol: Filters edges by absolute percentage based on a minimum threshold.
Computes combined hit-rate probability from leg confidence scores, handling missing values.
frontend/src/lib/parlay/exportSummary.ts: Generates a text summary of a parlay, including details, averages, and a disclaimer.
frontend/src/lib/verification/highConfid: Determines if a verification result meets the high-confidence threshold.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page explaining Bobbypicks, its purpose, and responsible gambling guidance.
frontend/src/pages/EdgeBoardPage.tsx: Displays filtered edge opportunities, handling login, loading, errors, and threshold-based empty states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing landing page with hero content, public metrics, and top edges for logged-in users.
frontend/src/pages/LivePicksPage.tsx: Shows live pick data with search, filters, ingestion diagnostics, and detailed failure states.
frontend/src/pages/ParlayBuilderPage.tsx: Provides a parlay builder UI for managing legs, calculating combined hit rates, and exporting parlay summaries.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Allows users to edit and save personal info, favorite teams, and preferences, with profile loading and validation.
frontend/src/pages/PropBoardPage.tsx: Displays a searchable, threshold-filtered list of prop edges, handling loading, auth, empty states, and rendering a table of opportunities.
frontend/src/pages/PropDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single prop including projections, edge data, verification confidence, and actions like adding to a parlay.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Provides admin and user settings including API key config, refresh actions, diagnostics, sensitivity settings, and admin promotion controls.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the application's routing structure using TanStack Router, including protected routes and page mappings.
frontend/src/state/parlay/ParlayProvider: Context provider managing parlay legs with add, remove, clear, and max-leg logic.
frontend/src/state/parlay/types.ts: Defines the ParlayLeg data shape including prop, edge, and verification fields.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color palette, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and pending feature requests related to building a Live Picks page with filtering, polling, and backend API support.
